description: Log manual time against a contract as the authenticated worker: a start/end window plus a required memo describing the work. The window must be in the past (within the manual-entry age limit), under the per-entry cap, and the contract policy must allow manual time. The entry lands on the worker time diary as MANUAL cells after reconciliation and is billable per contract policy. Requires time:write scope and the public API time-tracking feature.

contractId.description: Contract to log the time against.

endedAt.description: Work end as an ISO-8601 timestamp (exclusive).

memo.description: What was worked on — required; shown to the buyer on the diary.

startedAt.description: Work start as an ISO-8601 timestamp (e.g. 2026-07-03T09:00:00Z).

workProjectId.description: Optional project to attribute the time to.

name: opentrain_time_log
